Accept deferral of all three .sdata2 facts: source literals do not establish compiled pool reads, eight-byte size, placement, order or sharing. No compiled evidence supports resolving these claims.

Accept deferral of both forward-throw links: the implementation contains no directional selection or victim-release behavior, and its empty collision callback cannot establish a player-facing attack identity.

Accept deferral of all four grab-action links: partner cleanup and a GrabUnk-named continuation do not prove victim-grab membership. The continuation resets bookkeeping, derives a destination, assigns 0x184 before comparing with 0x156, takes the shown else path, and installs a deferred callback. Preserve that behavior without normalizing it into a gameplay concept.
